name: Entrance to Khazarad
desc1: This huge, high-ceilinged hall is a testament to the magnificent
desc2: skill of the dwarves. Vaulted arches support a roof covered with
desc3: intricately-carved stoneworks. The massive iron doors to the west
desc4: stand open, while two normal-sized iron doors are set in the north
desc5: and south walls. To the east, an archway large enough to admit the
desc6: entrance of a giant leads into the city itself.
